properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 36 sites are hash-sha3 matches on js-sha3 lockfile entries — 0.5.7 via ethers@5's @ethersproject/keccak256, 0.8.0 nested under ethereum-abi-types-generator's ethers. keccak256 is the Ethereum protocol hash (EIP-55 address checksums, tx/event hashing); consumed at runtime through ethers.utils.getAddress in src/common/utils/get-address.ts (app-level call site reported separately). Changeable here: dependency version; the keccak256 algorithm is fixed by the Ethereum protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (over sha.js) used by ethers' hdnode for BIP-39 mnemonic-to-seed derivation and by json-wallets for keystore v3 files. ethers ^5.0.26 is a production dependency of this published SDK, so the KDF ships to every consumer even though src/ never performs wallet operations. Quantum-safe (symmetric KDF) — A- rating appropriate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 13 sites are scrypt-js lockfile entries — 3.0.1 via the root ethers@5 tree (@ethersproject/json-wallets) and 2.0.4 nested under ethereum-abi-types-generator. scrypt is the password-based KDF for Ethereum Web3 Secret Storage (V3) encrypted JSON keystores. Runtime dependency; no keystore code path in the SDK's own src, but the capability ships to all consumers via ethers.
